section: New challenges to industry and commerce after bifurcation - loss of industrial base, relocation
subsections: Ease of Doing Business - AP's BRAP ranks

accepted.s: The Business Reforms Action Plan (BRAP) was first released for States in which year, with the collaboration of which institutions?
o: 2017, by the Ministry of Commerce and the World Bank
2014, by NITI Aayog and the Asian Development Bank
2015, by DIPP in collaboration with the World Bank
2016, by DPIIT in collaboration with the IMF
accepted.x: BRAP was first released for States in 2015 by DIPP with the World Bank.
accepted.tq: Use the year-agency-institution combination to distinguish closely related institutional arrangements.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - AP's BRAP ranks

accepted.s: What was the rank of Andhra Pradesh in the first BRAP assessment released for States in 2015?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh was ranked second in BRAP 2015.
accepted.tq: Numerical rank questions require separating the inaugural rank from later performance claims.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - AP's BRAP ranks

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding BRAP 2024:
1. It was the seventh edition of BRAP.
2. It contained 435 state-specific reform points.
3. It was the first edition of BRAP released for States.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: BRAP 2024 was the seventh edition and contained 435 state-specific reform points. The first edition was released in 2015, so statement 3 is false.
accepted.tq: Eliminate the historically impossible statement by comparing the edition number with the inaugural year.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - AP's BRAP ranks

accepted.s: The Single Desk Portal of Andhra Pradesh recorded what percentage of approvals within the stipulated Service Level Agreement during 2024–25?
accepted.x: The Single Desk Portal recorded 99.20% of approvals within the SLA during 2024–25.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the exact percentage from nearby numerical distractors.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - AP's BRAP ranks

accepted.s: Which organisation has begun the BRAP 2026 process?
accepted.x: DPIIT has begun the BRAP 2026 process.
accepted.tq: Use the department-name distinction between the earlier BRAP association and the current implementing authority.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - AP's BRAP ranks

accepted.s: In June 2026, the SIPB cleared how many proposals involving an investment amount of approximately ₹34,000 crore?
accepted.x: In June 2026, SIPB cleared 87 proposals worth ₹34,000 crore.
accepted.tq: Split the numerical pair and identify the exact proposal count rather than the investment value.

accepted.s: How many BHAVYA parks were proposed in Andhra Pradesh in August 2026?
accepted.x: Six BHAVYA parks were proposed in August 2026.
accepted.tq: Treat the count of proposed projects as a separate current-affairs figure.

accepted.s: Which of the following places and industrial developments are associated with the rebuilding of Rayalaseema as an industrial hub?
o: JSW, Visakhapatnam Steel Plant, Royal Enfield near Tirupati and the Pharma City
Kia, JSW, Hindustan Aeronautics near Tirupati and the Space City
Kia, JSW, Royal Enfield near Tirupati and the Space City
Kia, Cochin Shipyard, Royal Enfield near Vijayawada and the Space City
accepted.x: The industrial-hub development in Rayalaseema is associated with Kia, JSW, Royal Enfield near Tirupati and the Space City.
accepted.tq: Match the regional-development claim with the complete set of projects and location details.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the criticism concerning Andhra Pradesh's post-bifurcation economic support?
o: Only the backward-area grants were disputed; Section 94 incentives and SCS were accepted without controversy.
Section 94 incentives and backward-area grants exceeded the demands made by the State, while SCS was granted.
The criticism concerned BRAP rankings rather than incentives, grants or SCS.
Section 94 incentives and backward-area grants fell short of what was sought, along with the denial of SCS.
accepted.x: The criticism was that Section 94 incentives and backward-area grants fell short of what was asked, and that Special Category Status was denied.
accepted.tq: Find the option that preserves both elements of the controversy instead of reversing or omitting one.
